Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misattributed James Kirkwood Sr.’s death date as April 21, 1989, which belongs to James Kirkwood Jr., conflating two different individuals. This misassociation would incorrectly suggest Raymond Cannon (d. 1977) died first and could lead to the wrong film being chosen, had it not been corrected later.
